description:
Subscribe the user's own email to a Vibe Shipped newsletter: daily (new apps built with AI) or agent-brief (weekly AI coding tools and harnesses).
Use when: the user explicitly asks to subscribe and gives their own email.
Do not use for: any address the user did not provide.
Returns: a receipt usable to unsubscribe (DELETE /api/subscribe).
Limits: Write; idempotent per email and list.
Example: {"email":"me@example.com","list":"agent-brief"}
name: subscribe_newsletter
title: Subscribe to a Vibe Shipped newsletter
